## What changed?

Describe the player or developer problem and the change.

## How was it checked?

List relevant commands and, for visual or speech changes, include a screenshot or short recording. Note any device or browser limits.

## Checklist

- [ ] No keys, tokens, private conversations, or generated capture files are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests and build pass.
- [ ] Large character assets use Git LFS and their publication rights are confirmed.
